title: Tokyo, Monday October 5: the market, teamLab, sushi and Ginza
lead: The tuna auction at 5:30, breakfast at the market, teamLab and Tsukiji on your own. Yuuki meets you at Ginza Sushimasa at 12:00, and the afternoon is a walk through Ginza back to your hotel by about 15:30.
subject: Oct 5
pick: The market first, Ginza after lunch.
hero_alt: Buyers checking tuna on the auction floor at Toyosu Market
hero_cap: The tuna auction floor at Toyosu Market, seen from above.

workshop.lead: Everything before lunch is close together in Toyosu and Tsukiji. Your auction number and your teamLab passes are below. Show this page if anyone asks.
facts: Check-in 5:30 at the PR corner, Block 7, 3rd floor. Reception number 53241. The auction runs until about 6:25.
Two Premium Passes, already paid. Enter any time from 8:00 to 21:00 today. Skip the line and show the QR code at the Information Center.
12:00 at Ginza Sushimasa. Address and directions are at the bottom of this page.
steps: Check in at 5:30 with reception number 53241. You watch the auction through the window on the 3rd floor of Block 7.
Sushi and seafood bowls in the restaurant area of the market. Many places open at 5:00.

One stop on the Yurikamome line (Shijo-mae to Shin-toyosu), or a 5 minute taxi. Show the QR code at the Information Center; no need to queue. You walk barefoot inside and one room has knee-deep water.
About 15 minutes by taxi from teamLab. Tamagoyaki, grilled seafood and knives. From here, Sushimasa is a 10 minute walk.
workshop.note: If you are tired after the auction, skip teamLab, rest at the hotel and come straight to lunch at 12:00. The teamLab passes stay valid until 21:00 today.
photos: The auction floor from the deck

meet_text: Yuuki meets you at the restaurant at 12:00. It is a counter seat for three under Yuuki's name, and we order there. The restaurant is in a basement behind the Kabuki-za theatre.
meet_hint: 3 minutes on foot from Higashi-Ginza Station, about 10 minutes on foot from Tsukiji Outer Market. Phone 03-3541-5882. It is a counter, so please skip strong perfume.
footer: Questions on the day: message Yuuki on WhatsApp. Times are approximate.

print.title: Tokyo, Monday October 5
directions: From Tsukiji Outer Market, walk east toward Higashi-Ginza Station (about 10 minutes).
The restaurant is in the basement of the building at Ginza 5-14-5, behind the Kabuki-za.
Counter for three under Yuuki's name. Phone 03-3541-5882.
